what: A byte copy of engine/board_state.js, the MEDICHAM bar's definition of THE BOARD (HP, status and its counters, item, types, ability, boosts, volatiles with their clocks, party, field, side conditions). DODUO v2's pair gate reads `readMedi` from this copy so that a release-bound run opens no live engine byte (the photograph rule): the engine state it reads is frozen in the release, and so is its reader.
rule: Never edited. To move to a newer reader, copy it again and update this file; solver/tests/test-gates.js checks the digest.
